user_request: 题目需自然可读，参考英语一真题的材料、设问和干扰项，按已确认错因出题。

source_benchmarks.use: Reference 2018 English I question functions: detail, inference, vocabulary, attitude and title; not copied question text.
Study complete argument and attribution structure in 2018 Text 3, rather than replace it with a coaching dialogue.

review_checks: Each paragraph has an intelligible point and logical links.
Stem asks about the passage, not a fictional test taker.
Distractors use plausible topic, speaker, scope or action changes.
Correct answer has a locatable text basis and paraphrases its meaning.
Training targets stay hidden until after an answer.
Reading time allowance is question-specific; prior thresholds remain unchanged.

answer_position_policy.previous: A/B/C/D fixed at two each in every 8-question run; earlier explanations could reveal the remaining key.
answer_position_policy.current: Independent option permutations for newly created runs; saved prior permutations and results remain intact.
